name: DevX Version Tag Automation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  create-devx-tag:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get latest release tag
        id: get_release
        run: |
          LATEST_RELEASE=$(git ls-remote --tags origin | grep -E "^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+" | sort -V | tail -1 | cut -f2 | sed 's|refs/tags/||')
          echo "latest_release=$LATEST_RELEASE" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "Latest release tag: $LATEST_RELEASE"

      - name: Create devX tag
        if: env.latest_release != ''
        run: |
          set -e
          
          RELEASE_TAG="${{ env.latest_release }}"
          CURRENT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
          
          # Find highest existing devX tag for this release
          MAX_DEV_TAG=0
          for tag in $(git ls-remote --tags origin | grep "${RELEASE_TAG}\.dev" | cut -f2 | sed 's|refs/tags/||'); do
            DEV_NUM=$(echo "$tag" | sed "s/${RELEASE_TAG}\.dev//")
            if [[ "$DEV_NUM" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && [ "$DEV_NUM" -gt "$MAX_DEV_TAG" ]; then
              MAX_DEV_TAG="$DEV_NUM"
            fi
          done
          
          NEXT_DEV_TAG=$((MAX_DEV_TAG + 1))
          TAG_NAME="${RELEASE_TAG}.dev${NEXT_DEV_TAG}"
          
          # Check if tag already exists
          if git rev-parse "$TAG_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "Tag $TAG_NAME already exists, skipping"
            exit 0
          fi
          
          # Retry logic for tag creation
          MAX_RETRIES=3
          RETRY_COUNT=0
          while [ $RETRY_COUNT -lt $MAX_RETRIES ]; do
            if git tag "$TAG_NAME" "$CURRENT_COMMIT"; then
              echo "Successfully created tag: $TAG_NAME"
              git push origin "$TAG_NAME"
              echo "Pushed tag: $TAG_NAME"
              break
            else
              RETRY_COUNT=$((RETRY_COUNT + 1))
              echo "Failed to create tag, retry $RETRY_COUNT/$MAX_RETRIES"
              sleep 2
            fi
          done
          
          if [ $RETRY_COUNT -eq $MAX_RETRIES ]; then
            echo "Failed to create tag after $MAX_RETRIES attempts"
            exit 1
          fi
